_about: Spend-based (environmentally extended input-output) multipliers for when no activity data exists. GHG Protocol Scope 3 guidance treats spend-based results as the lowest-quality method; replace them with activity or supplier data where you can.
unit: kg CO2e per GBP spent (2023 prices, excluding VAT)
method: Cost in the plan currency -> USD -> GBP at 2023 average exchange rates (currency.json), times the multiplier for the mapped SIC group. Costs are not deflated to 2023 prices: no published UK price index for the event year is in the reference set, and leaving prices undeflated can only overstate emissions. The multipliers describe UK supply chains.

Performance.reason: Performers are bought as creative, arts and entertainment services.

Stage & set.reason: Temporary stages and sets are built and erected on site as specialised construction works.

Projection.reason: Projectors and media servers are normally hired: rental and leasing services.

Pitch art.reason: Pitch art is large printed or sewn fabric: textiles.

Music.reason: Musicians, composers and producers: creative, arts and entertainment services.

Cast & community.reason: Cast costs (choreography, rehearsal, stipends) are creative, arts and entertainment services.

Crowd participation.reason: Card mosaics and printed items are printing services; for electronic wristbands choose 26.

Special effects.reason: Pyrotechnics and effects consumables are other chemical products (SIC 20.51 explosives sits in this group).

Lighting.reason: Lighting fixtures are normally hired: rental and leasing services.

Broadcast.reason: Broadcast specials are motion picture, video and TV programme production services.

Sound.reason: Audio systems are normally hired: rental and leasing services.

Other.reason: Default for show elements: creative, arts and entertainment services.

Artist fees & travel.reason: Artist fees. Enter travel in the carbon calculator, not here, or it is counted twice.

Rehearsals.reason: Rehearsal fields, marquees and equipment are hired.

Venue & site.reason: Venue hire: sports services and amusement and recreation services.

Crew & labour.reason: Freelance crew through agencies: employment services.

Logistics & freight.reason: Land transport services. Use the activity calculator instead when you have tonne-km.

Accommodation.reason: Accommodation services. Use hotel nights in the calculator instead when you have them.

Sustainability.reason: Mitigation payments are not a purchase of goods or services that emit; no multiplier.

Other.reason: Default: creative, arts and entertainment services.
